verdict.rationale: The evidence documents live WebSocket streaming transcription with ~150ms latency, and an SDK that manages the WebSocket connection and session termination. Nothing in the pack shows streaming results being labeled as interim versus final, and nothing documents the finality semantics. The axis applies to a streaming speech-to-text API, so the lack of evidence makes this none, not na.

support.subject: As a developer, streaming results distinguish interim from final transcripts, with the finality semantics documented
